title: S1 sticky-pair — a pinned title beside a list that scrolls past it
idea: A short title column stays pinned in place while a long list scrolls past it. The reader keeps the heading in view for the whole band, so a list of forty items still has one visible frame around it.
risk: a still screenshot cannot show the value, so this one needs a short screen recording as evidence. Below the stacking breakpoint the pin is off and the band is a plain stack, a support column under four items never scrolls far enough to earn it, and a pinned column taller than the viewport traps its own bottom out of reach.
